body:
Measure actual dependency setup and test execution rather than checkout-only fanout.

- [ ] Use three real repositories: Rust, Python and TypeScript, with pinned revisions and reproducible commands.
- [ ] Measure fresh bootstrap, raw gate, warm incremental switching and bootstrap-input invalidation. Warm overhead must be below 15% of raw gate time.
- [ ] Run two concurrent slots with MAI_SLOT, MAI_PORT_BASE and private temp dirs; demonstrate collision resolution or document a failed criterion. Environment variables are cooperation, not sandboxing.
- [ ] Test cache reuse without stale outputs masking failures, ignored/untracked residue, cancellation and process-group cleanup. Record copy-on-write template availability and safe copy fallback.
- [ ] Commit throwaway scripts and report under docs/spikes/; defer overlay/lazy work unless measurements justify it.
title: S3: Measure warm validator costs and two-slot isolation
